    # Error-telemetry SDK for the operator-managed Sentry-protocol-compatible
    # error sink. Imported lazily in src/bernstein/cli/main.py and only
    # initialised when BERNSTEIN_TELEMETRY_DSN is set. Kept in dev so the
    # test-suite can exercise the no-op + initialised paths.
    "sentry-sdk[fastapi]>=2.20",
    # Cron expression parser. Optional at runtime - trigger_manager imports it
    # inside try/except ImportError and yields no events without it - but
    # required here so the cron-evaluation regression tests execute instead of
    # being skipped by importorskip. types-croniter below stubs the same
    # library for mypy.
    "croniter>=6.0",
    # Rendering-fetcher tests (#3120) exercise the headless browser against
    # a local fixture server. Runtime extra: bernstein[research-render].
    "playwright>=1.62.0",
    # NOTE: semgrep is intentionally NOT a dev dep. Its transitive pins
    # (click<8.2, opentelemetry-sdk<1.38) collide with our production
    # floors (click>=8.3.3, opentelemetry-sdk>=1.41.1). Install via
    # `uv tool install semgrep` (isolated env). See .github/workflows/ci.yml
    # and docs/contributing/testing.md.
    #
    # Type stubs for dependencies that ship no inline annotations. Mirror of
    # [dependency-groups].dev. Everything below is typeshed's own `types-*`
    # distribution except lxml-stubs (published by the lxml developers) and
    # boto3-stubs / botocore-stubs (published by the mypy_boto3 project).
    # Stub-only wheels: no runtime code, no import cost. They are dev-only
    # because they are consumed by `uv run mypy src`.
    "types-pyyaml>=6.0.12.20260724",  # pyyaml
    "types-jsonschema>=4.26.0.20260518",  # jsonschema
    "types-reportlab>=4.5.1.20260724",  # reportlab
    "types-defusedxml>=0.7.0.20260504",  # defusedxml
    "types-psutil>=7.2.2.20260518",  # psutil
    "types-croniter>=6.2.4.20260711",  # croniter
    "types-qrcode>=8.2.0.20260518",  # qrcode (gui extra)
    "types-grpcio>=1.82.1.20260724",  # grpcio (grpc extra)
    "types-grpcio-reflection>=1.0.0.20260508",  # grpcio-reflection (grpc extra)
    "lxml-stubs>=0.5.1",  # lxml, via signxml (SAML assertion parsing)
    "boto3-stubs>=1.43.56",  # boto3 (s3 / r2 extras), published by the mypy_boto3 project
    "botocore-stubs>=1.43.14",  # botocore, same publisher
]
grpc = ["grpcio>=1.68", "grpcio-tools>=1.68", "grpcio-reflection>=1.68", "protobuf>=7.35.1"]
voice = ["faster-whisper>=1.0.0", "sounddevice>=0.4.0", "numpy>=1.20.0"]
k8s = ["kubernetes>=35.0.0"]
# SPIFFE/SPIRE workload-identity integration
# (src/bernstein/core/identity/spiffe/workload_api.py). The py-spiffe SDK talks
# to a running SPIRE agent's Workload API to fetch X.509-SVIDs. Optional so the
# default self-contained Ed25519 identity path stays dependency-free and works
# with a truthy regression suite when the extra is absent. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[spiffe]'
spiffe = ["spiffe>=0.2"]
ml = ["scikit-learn>=1.5"]
# Browser activity driver (src/bernstein/core/orchestration/browser_driver.py).
# Declared empty (like `graphics` below) so a default install and the project
# lock stay lean and license-clean: the live `browser-use` backend pulls a large
# transitive tree with licenses outside the accepted set (see
# .github/workflows/dependency-review.yml), and vendoring it here would bind that
# surface onto every install. The recorded-tape driver runs every offline replay
# and verification path with no extra installed, and asking for a live driver
# without the backend raises a typed refusal naming the package to install.
# Enable the live driver on demand with: pip install 'browser-use>=0.7'.
browser = []
graphics = []  # term-image disabled: caps pillow<11, conflicts with CVE-2026-25990 fix
# OpenAI Agents SDK v2 integration (src/bernstein/adapters/openai_agents.py).
# Declared as an optional extra so users who don't spawn OpenAI Agents agents
# don't need the SDK installed.  Enable with: pip install 'bernstein[openai]'.
openai = ["openai-agents>=0.4.0"]
# Sandbox backend extras. Each pulls in the provider SDK for the
# corresponding SandboxBackend. Kept optional so minimal installs stay lean.
docker = ["docker>=7.1.0"]
e2b = ["e2b-code-interpreter>=1.0"]
modal = ["modal>=1.4.2"]
# Cloud artifact storage sinks. Each extra pulls in the provider SDK
# needed by the corresponding ArtifactSink. Kept optional so local-only
# installs stay lean. R2 reuses boto3 under the hood.
s3 = ["boto3>=1.43.6"]
gcs = ["google-cloud-storage>=3.10.1"]
azure = ["azure-storage-blob>=12.20"]
r2 = ["boto3>=1.43.6"]
# Chat-control bridge backends. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[telegram]'
# Standard Telegram bot integration via long-poll: configure the bot
# token (from @BotFather) and the chat id, no external services.
telegram = ["python-telegram-bot>=22.7"]
# Slack bidirectional driver over Socket Mode. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[slack]'
# Configure a Slack app with bot scopes (``chat:write``, ``commands``),
# enable Socket Mode, and set ``BERNSTEIN_SLACK_TOKEN`` (xoxb-...) plus
# ``BERNSTEIN_SLACK_APP_TOKEN`` (xapp-...) before invoking ``bernstein
# chat serve --platform=slack``.
slack = ["slack-sdk>=3.27", "aiohttp>=3.9"]
# Discord bidirectional driver over the gateway. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[discord]'
# Configure a Discord bot application in the developer portal, copy the
# bot token, and set ``BERNSTEIN_DISCORD_TOKEN`` before invoking
# ``bernstein chat serve --platform=discord``.
discord = ["discord.py>=2.4"]
# Microsoft Teams bidirectional driver over the Bot Framework. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[teams]'
# Register a bot in the Azure Bot Service, copy the app id and password, and
# set ``BERNSTEIN_TEAMS_TOKEN`` (app id) plus ``BERNSTEIN_TEAMS_APP_PASSWORD``
# (client secret) before invoking ``bernstein chat serve --platform=teams``.
teams = ["botbuilder-core>=4.15", "aiohttp>=3.9"]
# Contamination-resistant eval harness (SWE-bench Pro / Terminal-Bench 2.0 /
# SWE-rebench). Kept optional so production installs don't pull HuggingFace
# datasets unless the operator opts into the nightly leaderboard path.
# Enable with: pip install 'bernstein[eval]'
eval = ["datasets>=4.8.5", "huggingface-hub>=0.24"]
# Web GUI (Vite + React SPA + FastAPI mount). Static assets ship with the
# wheel under src/bernstein/gui/static/ (see artifacts). Python deps stay
# minimal so TUI users keep zero overhead. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[gui]'
# then: bernstein gui serve
gui = [
    "sse-starlette>=2.1.0",
    # Terminal QR rendering for ``bernstein gui qr`` and the
    # ``--tunnel`` flag of ``bernstein gui serve`` (#1218). Pure Python,
    # MIT-licensed, no native deps. The qr renderer ships a fallback
    # placeholder when this extra is absent so minimal installs do not
    # crash - they just print a "install qrcode" diagnostic.
    "qrcode>=7.4",
]
# OpenTelemetry OTLP/gRPC exporter for GenAI semantic conventions
# (src/bernstein/core/observability/otlp_exporter.py). The exporter is a
# no-op when this extra is absent or BERNSTEIN_OTEL_ENDPOINT is unset, so
# minimal installs do not pay the gRPC import cost. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[otel]'
otel = [
    "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc>=1.41.1",
]
# Error-telemetry SDK wired to an operator-managed Sentry-protocol-compatible
# error sink (src/bernstein/cli/main.py:_init_error_telemetry). The SDK is
# imported lazily and only initialises when BERNSTEIN_TELEMETRY_DSN is set, so
# minimal installs pay zero overhead. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[observability]'
observability = [
    "sentry-sdk[fastapi]>=2.20",
]
research-render = [
    "playwright>=1.62.0",
]
# TRACE 0.2 Trust Record emitter (src/bernstein/core/observability/trust_record.py).
# Optional so minimal installs stay dependency-free. Enable with:
#   pip install 'bernstein[trace]'
trace = ["agentrust-trace>=0.11,<0.12"]

[project.scripts]
bernstein = "bernstein.cli.main:cli"
bernstein-worker = "bernstein.core.worker:main"
bernstein-bench = "bernstein.eval.bench.bench_cli:bench_group"
verify-audit-receipt = "bernstein.core.verifier.audit_receipt_verifier:main"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.plugins"]
# Lifecycle/event plugins (hookimpl classes). Example:
# my_plugin = "my_package:MyPlugin"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.adapters"]
# Third-party CLI agent adapters (CLIAdapter subclasses). Example:
# myagent = "my_package.adapter:MyAgentAdapter"
# Then use: bernstein run --cli myagent plan.yaml

[project.entry-points."bernstein.gates"]
# Custom quality gates (GatePlugin subclasses). Example:
# my_gate = "my_package.gates:MyGate"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.triggers"]
# Custom trigger sources (normalize external events into tasks). Example:
# jira = "my_package.triggers:JiraTriggerSource"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.reporters"]
# Custom reporters (hookimpl classes that emit run summaries). Example:
# slack = "my_package.reporters:SlackReporter"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.sandbox_backends"]
# Sandbox backends (SandboxBackend protocol implementations).
# First-party backends (worktree, docker) ship in core and are registered
# by bernstein.core.sandbox.registry directly; plugin authors register
# additional backends (e2b, modal, cloud providers ...) via this group.
# Example:
# e2b = "bernstein.core.sandbox.backends.e2b:E2BSandboxBackend"
# modal = "bernstein.core.sandbox.backends.modal:ModalSandboxBackend"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.skill_sources"]
# Progressive-disclosure skill packs. Each entry resolves to a
# zero-arg factory returning a ``bernstein.core.skills.SkillSource``.
# Example:
# my-data-pack = "my_pack.skills:source"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.storage_sinks"]
# Pluggable artifact storage sinks. First-party sinks
# (local_fs, s3, gcs, azure_blob, r2) ship in core and are registered
# eagerly by bernstein.core.storage.registry; plugin authors register
# additional sinks (custom providers, domain-specific wrappers ...) via
# this group. Example:
# my_sink = "my_pkg.storage:MyArtifactSink"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.spec_quality_rules"]
# Spec-quality checklist rules (Rule factories). Each entry resolves to a
# zero-arg callable returning a
# ``bernstein.core.planning.spec_quality.Rule`` instance.
# Example:
# stakeholder = "my_pkg.spec_rules:stakeholder_factory"

[project.entry-points."bernstein.notification_sinks"]
# Outbound notification drivers (release 1.9). First-party drivers
# (telegram, slack, discord, email_smtp, webhook, shell) ship in core
# and are registered eagerly by bernstein.core.notifications.registry;
# plugin authors register additional drivers (PagerDuty, Opsgenie,
# Mattermost, ...) via this group. Each entry resolves to a callable
# whose signature is ``factory(config: dict[str, Any]) -> NotificationSink``
# and the entry name is the ``kind`` referenced from
# ``bernstein.yaml::notifications.sinks[*].kind``. Example:
# pagerduty = "my_pkg.notify:PagerDutySink"

[tool.hatch.build]
# NOTE: do NOT add src/bernstein/ entries here.  Every file under src/
# ships production code that the runtime imports -- either directly or
# via the _CoreRedirectFinder in core/__init__.py.  Previously 18 core/
# sub-packages plus three cli/run_*.py helpers were excluded (v1.8.7..
# v1.8.9 wheels on PyPI are all broken because of this); `pip install
# bernstein && bernstein --version` failed with `ModuleNotFoundError:
# No module named 'bernstein.core.config'` and similar because the
# redirect map / import chain points to files stripped from the wheel.
exclude = [
    ".sdd/",
    "tests/",
    "scripts/",
    "docs/",
    ".github/",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/bernstein"]
# Eval golden fixtures live INSIDE src/bernstein/eval/golden_data/ so they
# ship by virtue of being inside the package tree.  ``artifacts`` is listed
# explicitly to pin the *.md inclusion even if a future ``include`` /
# ``exclude`` rewrite tries to whitelist only *.py.  Loader:
# ``bernstein.eval.golden._packaged_tier_files`` (importlib.resources).
# .sdd/ MUST stay out of the repo (Repo hygiene CI gate); the operator
# override path .sdd/eval/golden/<tier>/*.md is still consulted first.
artifacts = [
    "src/bernstein/eval/golden_data/**/*.md",
    # Recipe golden traces - YAML fixtures that pin the resolved
    # workflow shape for each bundled recipe.  Loaded by the eval
    # harness to catch drift after refactors.
    "src/bernstein/eval/golden_data/**/*.yaml",
    # Web GUI built assets - Vite output committed to the package tree so
    # the wheel ships pre-built. Rebuild with: cd web && npm run build.
    "src/bernstein/gui/static/**/*",
    "src/bernstein/dashboard/static/**/*",
    # microVM launcher source. The libkrun monitor spawns one process per VM
    # and, on macOS, that process must carry the hypervisor entitlement, so the
    # binary is compiled and signed on the operator's host from this source
    # (`bernstein sandbox microvm-launcher`). Shipping the source rather than a
    # binary keeps the wheel platform-independent and lets the link step resolve
    # the local libkrun prefix. Loader:
    # bernstein.core.sandbox.backends._libkrun.launcher_source_dir.
    "src/bernstein/core/sandbox/backends/_libkrun_launcher/*.c",
    "src/bernstein/core/sandbox/backends/_libkrun_launcher/*.plist",
    # SDD ticket schemas. Shipped alongside the validator so downstream
    # projects can lint their .sdd/backlog tickets via importlib.resources
    # without a source checkout. Loader: bernstein.sdd.validator.load_schema.
    "src/bernstein/sdd/schema/*.json",
    # MCP per-tool input schemas (issue #1406). The orchestrator-side input
    # firewall loads them at startup to validate every incoming MCP tool
    # call. Loader: bernstein.mcp.input_validation.load_registry.
    "src/bernstein/mcp/tool_schemas/*.json",
    # OSCAL v1.1.0 assessment-results schema for compliance exports.
    "src/bernstein/compliance/oscal_schema/*.json",
    # Doctor doc-suggestion seed list. Curated list of common documentation
    # gaps surfaced by `bernstein doctor --suggest-docs`. Operator refreshes
    # it on each release. Loader:
    # bernstein.cli.doctor.suggest_docs.load_unanswered_topics.
    "src/bernstein/_default_templates/docs/*.json",
    # Tracker ingest event-type catalogue (#5132). Schema-validated YAML of
    # canonical event names; GitHub/GitLab parsers map through it only.
    # Loader: bernstein.core.trackers.event_catalogue.load_event_catalogue.
    "src/bernstein/core/trackers/event_catalogue.yaml",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include]
"templates/prompts" = "bernstein/_default_templates/prompts"
"templates/bernstein.yaml" = "bernstein/_default_templates/bernstein.yaml"
# Progressive-disclosure skill packs - shipped alongside the wheel so
# installed packages get the index without requiring a checkout of
# templates/.
"templates/skills" = "bernstein/_default_templates/skills"
"templates/roles" = "bernstein/_default_templates/roles"
# Review pipeline DSL - built-in stage templates and the default 3-phase
# pipeline. Loaded by bernstein.core.quality.review_pipeline at runtime
# when users omit a pipeline path.
"templates/review" = "bernstein/_default_templates/review"
# Lethal-trifecta capability matrix declarations.  Bundled so the
# default-deny check can find tags right after pip install.
"templates/capabilities" = "bernstein/_default_templates/capabilities"
# Provenance trust-class source map (issue #2513). Bundled so tool-result
# taint classification resolves right after pip install.
"templates/provenance" = "bernstein/_default_templates/provenance"
# Stock YAML workflow manifests (#1108) shipped with the wheel so
# `bernstein workflow list` / `... run <name>` resolve immediately
# without requiring a source checkout.
"templates/workflows" = "bernstein/_default_templates/workflows"
# Plan templates (#4877) for `bernstein templates list|use`. They lived at
# the repo root under plans/, which is the user's own working directory, and
# so shipped in no wheel at all - the command was dead on every install.
"templates/plans" = "bernstein/_default_templates/plans"
# First-class recipe library - parameterised workflows for common
# operator tasks (refactor-glob, bump-dependency, add-tests-for-module,
# license-audit, regenerate-docs).  Shipped in the wheel so
# `bernstein recipes list|show|run` resolves immediately.
"templates/recipes" = "bernstein/_default_templates/recipes"
# Per-task criterion profile presets (issue #1346).  Shipped in the
# wheel so `bernstein run --criterion-profile safety-first` resolves
# without a source checkout, mirroring the mode_profile pattern.
"templates/criterion_profiles" = "bernstein/_default_templates/criterion_profiles"
# Blast-radius detector defaults (#1322) so the reversibility gate finds
# its rule list without requiring a source checkout.
"templates/blast-radius" = "bernstein/_default_templates/blast-radius"
# Built-in team manifests (#2248) so `team_manifest: python` and the
# `bernstein team` commands resolve right after pip install.
"templates/teams" = "bernstein/_default_templates/teams"
# Packaged scenario library for `bernstein scenario list|run` and
# `bernstein routine ...`. Resolved by
# bernstein.core.planning.scenario_library.packaged_scenarios_dir; without
# this entry the commands see an empty library on every pip install.
"templates/scenarios" = "bernstein/_default_templates/scenarios"
# Adapter admission evidence (#3547). The verdict `bernstein adapters
# verify --seal` derives is a projection of the pinned contract's bytes and
# the golden-transcript replay, so both have to be resolvable off a pip
# install or every adapter falls back to a skip-shaped refusal
# (`no_contract` / `no_transcript`) and the seal can never go green outside
# a dev checkout. Both trees are shipped verbatim rather than filtered, so
# an installed host derives the same replay fingerprint a checkout does.
# Loaders: bernstein.adapters._contract.CONTRACTS_DIR and
# bernstein.adapters.admission.golden_transcripts_dir.
"tests/contract/contracts" = "bernstein/_default_templates/adapter_contracts"
"tests/golden" = "bernstein/_default_templates/adapter_golden"
# Cross-vendor agent-plugin assets (#2369): the bernstein-run skill plus
# the plugin command/agent/rule files, so `bernstein skills package
# install` resolves the bundled tree right after pip install. Loader:
# bernstein.core.skills.packaging.packaged_asset_root.
"skills" = "bernstein/_default_templates/agent_plugin/skills"
"commands" = "bernstein/_default_templates/agent_plugin/commands"
"agents" = "bernstein/_default_templates/agent_plugin/agents"
"rules" = "bernstein/_default_templates/agent_plugin/rules"
".mcp.json" = "bernstein/_default_templates/agent_plugin/.mcp.json"
".plugin/plugin.json" = "bernstein/_default_templates/agent_plugin/.plugin/plugin.json"
# Standalone audit-receipt verifier. The `verify-audit-receipt` console
# script and `bernstein audit receipt verify` run this file as a subprocess
# (it imports only stdlib + cryptography + cbor2, never bernstein). It lives
# at the repo root under tools/, so without this entry every pip / uv / conda
# install exited 2 with "can't open file .../tools/verify_audit_receipt.py".
# Loader: bernstein.core.verifier.audit_receipt_verifier.VERIFIER_SCRIPT.
"tools/verify_audit_receipt.py" = "bernstein/_default_templates/tools/verify_audit_receipt.py"
# ascii_logo.md now lives in-package at src/bernstein/_default_templates/ -
# no force-include needed. The dev-repo copy at docs/assets/ascii_logo.md is
# the display fallback read by cli/display/splash_v2.py when running from a
# source checkout.

[tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist.force-include]
# Wheel force-include sources must also exist inside the sdist: `uv build`
# (and any pip install from the sdist) builds the wheel FROM the sdist, and
# hatchling hard-fails on a missing force-include source. Every other wheel
# force-include source above (templates/, skills, ...) survives into the
# sdist by default, but these two live under tests/, which the global
# [tool.hatch.build] exclude drops - so they are re-included here verbatim,
# at their checkout paths. Guard:
# tests/unit/test_adapter_verification_data_in_wheel.py.
"tests/contract/contracts" = "tests/contract/contracts"
"tests/golden" = "tests/golden"

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
line-length = 120
src = ["src"]
extend-exclude = [
    "src/bernstein/core/grpc_gen",
    "scripts/gen_tickets_*.py",
    "scripts/gen_roadmap_*.py",
    "scripts/convert_tickets_*.py",
    # Intentionally vulnerable synthetic codebase used by the
    # security-pentest eval scenario. Linting it makes no sense; the
    # files exist so the security role can find seeded findings.
    "tests/fixtures/eval/security_pentest/**",
    # Gate-evasion corpus fixtures containing intentional syntax errors,
    # broken code, and mock patterns used to evaluate quality gates.
    "src/bernstein/eval/cases/gate_evasion/**",
    # Cookiecutter source templates with Jinja-interpolated identifiers
    # ({{cookiecutter.X}}) that ruff cannot parse as Python.
    "templates/**",
]

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"
skip-magic-trailing-comma = false
line-ending = "lf"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "UP", "B", "SIM", "TCH", "RUF"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]

"src/bernstein/evolution/report.py" = ["E501"]

"src/bernstein/adapters/mock.py" = ["E501"]
"src/bernstein/compliance/eu_ai_act.py" = ["E501", "RUF012"]
"src/bernstein/core/differential_privacy.py" = ["RUF002"]
"src/bernstein/core/license_scanner.py" = ["E501"]
"src/bernstein/core/memory_integrity.py" = ["E501", "RUF003"]
"src/bernstein/core/seed_config.py" = ["TC001"]
"src/bernstein/core/server_models.py" = ["TC001"]
"src/bernstein/core/server_middleware.py" = ["TC002"]
"src/bernstein/core/orchestration/decomposition_emitter.py" = ["TC001"]
"src/bernstein/core/orchestration/decomposition_proposal.py" = ["TC001"]
"src/bernstein/core/spawner_merge.py" = ["TC003"]
"src/bernstein/core/spawner_worktree.py" = ["TC003"]
"src/bernstein/core/spawner_warm_pool.py" = ["TC003"]
"src/bernstein/core/server_supervisor.py" = ["TC003"]
"src/bernstein/core/runtime_state.py" = ["TC003"]
"src/bernstein/cli/frame_buffer.py" = ["TC003", "RUF002"]
"src/bernstein/cli/gradients.py" = ["TC003", "RUF002", "RUF003"]
"src/bernstein/cli/image_renderer.py" = ["TC003"]
"benchmarks/run_benchmark.py" = ["E501", "RUF002"]
"scripts/generate_roadmap_tickets.py" = ["E501", "RUF001"]
# Ticket/roadmap generators have long inline strings and unicode symbols
"scripts/gen_tickets_*.py" = ["E501", "RUF001"]
"scripts/gen_roadmap_*.py" = ["E501", "RUF001"]
"scripts/convert_tickets_*.py" = ["RUF001"]
"tests/pentest/*.py" = ["SIM105"]
"sdk/python/src/bernstein_sdk/adapters/github_actions.py" = ["E501"]
"sdk/python/src/bernstein_sdk/adapters/jira.py" = ["E501"]
"tests/**/*.py" = ["E402", "E501", "E741", "RUF002", "RUF003", "RUF012", "RUF043", "SIM108", "SIM117", "TC002", "TC003", "TC006"]
# Bug-hunt suite uses ambiguous unicode (homoglyphs, ZWS) intentionally for bypass tests
"tests/property/test_capability_matrix_bughunt.py" = ["RUF001", "RUF002", "RUF003"]
# Example plugins are worked-example packages; runtime imports survive
# ``TYPE_CHECKING`` blocks because tests rely on them at runtime (e.g.
# ``pytest.fail``) and the adapter code uses ``Path`` in concrete
# function signatures, not just hints.
"examples/plugins/**/*.py" = ["TC001", "TC002", "TC003"]

[tool.pyright]
pythonVersion = "3.12"
typeCheckingMode = "strict"
include = ["src"]
# Agent-created modules pending type annotation cleanup.
# TODO: remove excludes as each module is cleaned up (#345h hygiene tickets)
# Every entry must name a path that exists on disk; stale excludes are a
# silent no-op after moves (issue #4864). tests/unit/test_pyright_excludes.py
# pins that invariant.
exclude = [

[tool.mypy]
# Repo-wide mypy settings for the documented `uv run mypy src` command.
# This run is advisory: mypy has a large pre-existing backlog because it
# never actually parsed the tree (see the note on `python_version` below).
# The subset that gates CI lives in mypy.gate.ini, the same way the
# repo-wide pyright run is advisory and pyrightconfig.strict.json gates.
#
# `python_version` is pinned rather than inherited from whatever
# interpreter happens to run mypy. It matches [tool.pyright] pythonVersion
# and the `requires-python` floor. Note that this pins the *target*
# version only - PEP 695 `type` aliases (11 of them in src/) still need
# the interpreter running mypy to be >= 3.12, because mypy parses with the
# host `ast` module. That is why mypy is a declared dev dependency: an
# undeclared `uv run mypy` falls through to a PATH mypy that may be bound
# to an older interpreter, and the run then aborts on the first alias with
# `Invalid syntax` before checking anything.
python_version = "3.12"
files = ["src"]
namespace_packages = true
warn_unused_configs = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
# Legacy `bernstein.core.*` / `bernstein.cli.*` import paths are served at
# runtime by the `sys.meta_path` finders in src/bernstein/core/__init__.py
# and src/bernstein/cli/__init__.py, not by files on disk. No static
# checker can follow a meta-path redirect, so these resolve to nothing.
module = ["bernstein.*"]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
# Installed dependencies that ship neither a `py.typed` marker nor a
# published stub distribution. Checked against PyPI: there is no
# `types-asn1crypto`, `types-kubernetes` or `types-e2b-code-interpreter`,
# and the `google.cloud` namespace package carries no marker of its own
# even though the individual `google-cloud-*` distributions do.
#
# Every other untyped import in the tree is resolved by a real stub
# package in [dependency-groups].dev instead - see the block there. This
# list is the residue, and it should shrink as upstream adds markers, not
# grow. Adding an entry here means "no type information exists anywhere";
# it is not a place to park a package we simply have not stubbed yet.
module = [
    "asn1crypto.*",  # RFC 3161 ASN.1 parsing, core/security/rfc3161_verifier.py
    "e2b_code_interpreter.*",  # `e2b` extra, core/sandbox/backends/e2b.py
    "google.cloud.*",  # `gcs` extra, core/security/secrets_broker.py
    "kubernetes.*",  # `k8s` extra, core/orchestration/operator.py
]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
# Optional backends imported inside a function body behind a try/except
# ImportError, with a typed fallback when absent. They are absent from the
# environment `uv run mypy src` sees - the first group is not declared in
# [project] at all, the second is behind an extra that a plain `uv sync`
# does not install - so mypy reports `import-not-found`.
#
# `ignore_missing_imports` only applies to an import that fails to
# resolve. Where the package is present and ships inline annotations
# (`datasets`, `spiffe`, and most of the first group), mypy reads the real
# types and this override does nothing - so it silences the "not
# installed" noise without masking a typed surface.
#
# The first group is deliberately not installed rather than un-stubbed:
# pulling it into the dev group to read those annotations would add native
# toolchains (sounddevice/PortAudio, weasyprint/cairo+pango), multi-
# gigabyte ML runtimes (faster-whisper), and import-time-patching APM
# agents (ddtrace, newrelic) to every CI job.
module = [
    "asyncpg.*",  # core/persistence/store_postgres.py, cli/commands/status_cmd.py
    "ddtrace.*",  # core/observability/apm_integration.py
    "faster_whisper.*",  # cli/commands/voice_cmd.py
    "newrelic.*",  # core/observability/apm_integration.py
    "redis.*",  # core/persistence/store_redis.py
    "sigstore.*",  # core/security/{sigstore_attestation,audit_receipt}.py
    "sounddevice.*",  # cli/commands/voice_cmd.py
    "tiktoken.*",  # tui/context_tokens.py
    "weasyprint.*",  # core/observability/postmortem.py
    "zstandard.*",  # core/observability/trace_store.py
    # Declared extras, absent from a plain `uv sync`:
    "datasets.*",  # `eval` extra, benchmark/{swe_bench,programbench}.py
    "spiffe.*",  # `spiffe` extra, core/identity/spiffe/workload_api.py
    "sklearn.*",  # core/tokens/context_compression.py, core/planning/duration_predictor.py
    "z3.*",       # core/quality/formal_verification.py
    "playwright.async_api.*",  # core/orchestration/rendering_fetcher.py
]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "8.0"
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
# Tests use explicit @pytest.mark.asyncio - keep strict mode to avoid
# auto-collecting unmarked async tests and breaking existing suites.
asyncio_mode = "strict"
addopts = [
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
]
markers = [
    "ci: tests that run as part of CI for every release",
    "auth_enabled: opt out of the autouse auth-disabled shim (tests that exercise auth defaults)",
    "audit_key_real: opt out of the autouse audit-key path isolation (tests that exercise the real resolution logic)",
    "cluster_e2e: real-process cluster harness tests; skipped by default, run via the cluster-e2e workflow",
    "slow: long-running tests (> ~5s); skipped by default in fast feedback runs",
    "integration: end-to-end / subprocess-driven integration tests; selectable via -m integration in CI",
    "stress: resource-leak / memory-growth / deadlock stress tests (TC-C); gated off by default CI, run nightly via `-m stress`",
    "allow_network: opt out of the autouse unit no-network guard (rare; a genuine integration test belongs in tests/integration/ instead)",
    "protocol: protocol compatibility tests; applied to every item under tests/protocol/ by that directory's conftest, and run by the publish workflow's release gate",
    "auditor_question: binds one conformance vector under tests/integration/conformance/auditor/ to the question it answers; the argument is a question number registered in that suite's questions.py",
    "whole_tree_guard: asserts an invariant over the whole source tree by scanning it; no diff produces an import edge to these, so `scripts/run_tests.py --affected` selects them on every pull request regardless of what changed",
]
# Visible warnings without converting to errors; individual tests or runs
# can tighten via `pytest -W error::DeprecationWarning`.
filterwarnings = [
    "default",
    "ignore::PendingDeprecationWarning",
    "ignore::ResourceWarning",
]

[tool.uv]
# The checked-in gRPC gencode under src/bernstein/core/grpc_gen/ carries
# `Protobuf Python Version: 7.35.1` and calls ValidateProtobufRuntimeVersion()
# at import time, which rejects any runtime from an older major. The modal SDK
# caps protobuf below 7.0, so the `grpc` and `modal` extras cannot share one
# environment. Declaring the conflict keeps the universal lock resolvable and
# turns a former import-time VersionError into an install-time resolution
# error, which is where a dependency conflict belongs.
#
# `otel` has the same shape as `grpc` here, not a different one:
# opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc>=1.41.1 pins protobuf==7.35.1 (same
# generated-code floor as the checked-in gRPC gencode above), which modal's
# <7.0 cap rules out just as directly. Undeclared, this doesn't fail as a
# known-incompatible pair - it fails as "your project's requirements are
# unsatisfiable" from the *whole* lockfile, which is what aborted every `uv`
# dependency-update run rather than just the two extras that actually clash
# (#4088).
conflicts = [[{ extra = "grpc" }, { extra = "modal" }], [{ extra = "otel" }, { extra = "modal" }]]
# spiffe 0.3.1 caps pyjwt below 2.14, but pyjwt 2.13 carries ten published
# advisories fixed in 2.14.0 and nothing in the spiffe extra depends on the
# behaviour that cap guards. The override lets the universal lock resolve
# pyjwt to a patched release; drop it once spiffe lifts its cap.
override-dependencies = ["pyjwt>=2.14"]

# bundled stubs (e.g. numpy/__init__.pyi), which mypy rejects with a syntax
# error under python_version < 3.12. Skipping numpy's stubs instead is not an
# option — that types numpy as Any and cascades 130+ strict errors through
# first-party array code. The 3.10 support floor (requires-python = ">=3.10")

# 3.11 / 3.12 interpreters; mypy stays a pure type gate.

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ruff — comprehensive Python linting
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py310"
# Frozen surfaces excluded from lint — scheduled for removal in v5.0
extend-exclude = [
  "src/mycelium_fractal_net/crypto/",
  "src/mycelium_fractal_net/signal/",
  "src/mycelium_fractal_net/core/federated.py",
  "src/mycelium_fractal_net/core/stdp.py",
  "src/mycelium_fractal_net/core/turing.py",
  "src/mycelium_fractal_net/core/reaction_diffusion_compat.py",
  "src/mycelium_fractal_net/analytics/legacy_features.py",
  "research/",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
  "E",     # pycodestyle errors
  "W",     # pycodestyle warnings
  "F",     # pyflakes
  "I",     # isort
  "B",     # flake8-bugbear — opinionated bug detection
  "C4",    # flake8-comprehensions — unnecessary list/dict comprehension
  "UP",    # pyupgrade — modernize syntax for target Python
  "SIM",   # flake8-simplify — simplifiable constructs
  "PT",    # flake8-pytest-style — pytest best practices
  "RUF",   # ruff-specific rules
  "S",     # flake8-bandit — security checks
  "A",     # flake8-builtins — shadowing built-ins
  "C90",   # mccabe complexity
  "DTZ",   # flake8-datetimez — naive datetime usage
  "T20",   # flake8-print — print() in production code
  "PIE",   # flake8-pie — misc lints
  "PLC",   # pylint convention
  "PLE",   # pylint error
  "PLW",   # pylint warning
  "TID",   # flake8-tidy-imports — banned imports
  "TCH",   # flake8-type-checking — move imports to TYPE_CHECKING
  "PERF",  # perflint — performance anti-patterns
  "FLY",   # flynt — f-string conversion
  "FURB",  # refurb — modern Python idioms
]
ignore = [
  "E402",    # module-level import not at top (needed for conditional imports)
  "S101",    # assert usage (allowed in tests, banned in src via per-file)
  "S311",    # pseudo-random generators (acceptable for simulation seeds)
  "B008",    # function call in default argument (FastAPI Depends pattern)
  "UP007",   # X | Y union syntax (keep Optional for readability in complex signatures)
  "SIM108",  # ternary operator (readability over brevity for scientific code)
  "C901",    # too complex (handled by C90 mccabe with explicit threshold)
  "PLW2901", # loop variable overwritten (common in numeric code)
  "S603",    # subprocess call (needed in scripts)
  "S607",    # partial executable path (needed in scripts)
  "PLC0415", # import-outside-top-level (lazy imports by design for optional deps)
  "RUF002",  # ambiguous-unicode-character-docstring (μM, α, β are scientific notation)
  "RUF001",  # ambiguous-unicode-character-string (same)
  "RUF003",  # ambiguous-unicode-character-comment (same)
  "PLW0603", # global-statement (registry pattern for causal rules, detection config)
  "RUF043",  # pytest-raises-ambiguous-pattern (acceptable in test assertions)
  "PERF203", # try-except-in-loop (necessary for resilient iteration over scenarios)
  "PERF401", # manual-list-comprehension (readability over micro-optimization in scientific code)
  "PLW1510", # subprocess-run-without-check (scripts handle errors explicitly)
  "RUF012",  # mutable-class-default (dataclass fields with default_factory pattern)
  "SIM105",  # suppressible-exception (explicit try/except clearer than contextlib.suppress)
  "PT011",   # pytest-raises-too-broad (acceptable for integration tests)
  "PT012",   # pytest-raises-with-multiple-statements (test readability)
  "PT017",   # pytest-assert-in-except (intentional test pattern)
  "E741",    # ambiguous-variable-name (I, F, H, N are standard in scientific code)
  "S110",    # try-except-pass (intentional for optional features with fail-closed pattern)
  "T201",    # print (used in CLI, scripts, and cognitive functions)
  "E501",    # line-too-long (handled by formatter, allow in complex expressions)
  "A002",    # builtin-argument-shadowing (id= in rule_registry is domain convention)
  "B039",    # mutable-contextvar-default (logging config pattern)
  "S104",    # hardcoded-bind-all-interfaces (API server binds 0.0.0.0 by design)
  "S105",    # hardcoded-password-string (false positive on enum/config field names)
  "S112",    # try-except-continue (rate limiter resilience pattern)
  "SIM102",  # collapsible-if (readability over compactness in gate logic)
  "DTZ003",  # call-datetime-utcnow (UTC usage intentional in timestamps)
  "DTZ005",  # call-datetime-now-without-tzinfo (same)
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"src/**/__init__.py" = [
  "F401",    # unused-import: __init__.py re-exports are intentional public API
]
"tests/**/*.py" = [
  "S101",    # assert is fine in tests
  "S105",    # hardcoded passwords in test fixtures
  "S106",    # hardcoded passwords in test arguments
  "T20",     # print in tests is acceptable
  "PLR2004", # magic values in tests are fine
]
"scripts/**/*.py" = [
  "T20",     # print is expected in CLI scripts
  "S603",    # subprocess calls in scripts
  "S607",    # partial path in scripts
]
"src/mycelium_fractal_net/cli.py" = [
  "T20",     # print is the correct output mechanism for CLI
]
"src/mycelium_fractal_net/__main__.py" = [
  "T20",     # print is the correct output for CLI entrypoint
]
"src/mycelium_fractal_net/integration/crypto_adapters.py" = [
  "B904",    # frozen adapter — exception chaining deferred to v5.0
]
"src/mycelium_fractal_net/experiments/**/*.py" = [
  "T20",     # print for experiment output
]
"src/mycelium_fractal_net/pipelines/reporting.py" = [
  "E501",    # HTML templates contain long lines by nature
]
"src/mycelium_fractal_net/pipelines/scenarios/**/*.py" = [
  "T20",     # print in __main__ blocks
]
"benchmarks/**/*.py" = [
  "T20",     # print for benchmark output
  "S101",    # assert in benchmarks
]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 15

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["mycelium_fractal_net"]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-bugbear]
extend-immutable-calls = ["fastapi.Depends", "fastapi.Query", "fastapi.Path"]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-bandit]
check-typed-exception = true

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  mypy — gradual strict typing
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.10"
strict = true
ignore_missing_imports = true
namespace_packages = true
pretty = true
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
show_error_codes = true
no_implicit_optional = true
strict_equality = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "tests.*"
disallow_untyped_defs = true

# Core, analytics, neurochem: strict typing enforced — CI gate blocks merge
[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = [
    "mycelium_fractal_net.types.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.security.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.core.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.analytics.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.neurochem.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.interpretability.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.self_reading.*",
]
disallow_untyped_defs = true
warn_return_any = true
no_implicit_optional = true
strict_equality = true

# Frozen / transport / ML modules: errors reported but not blocking
# Goal: remove this override entirely by v5.0
[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = [
    "mycelium_fractal_net.model",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.signal.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.numerics.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.api",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.metrics",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.intelligence",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.pipelines.*",
    "mycelium_fractal_net.integration.*",
]
disallow_untyped_defs = false
# NOTE: ignore_errors removed — type errors are now visible and trackable

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  coverage — enforced minimum
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["mycelium_fractal_net"]
branch = true
parallel = true
omit = [
  "*/tests/*",
  "*/experiments/*",
  "*/load_tests/*",
]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
precision = 2
fail_under = 80
exclude_lines = [
  "pragma: no cover",
  "if __name__ == .__main__.",
  "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
  "raise NotImplementedError",
  "@overload",
  "\\.\\.\\.",
]

[tool.coverage.xml]
output = "coverage.xml"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  bandit — security static analysis
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
[tool.bandit]
exclude_dirs = ["tests", "benchmarks", "scripts", "examples"]
skips = ["B101", "B311"]

[tool.ruff]
# Eval fixtures plant logging/style defects on purpose for the skills to find (ADR-0021).
extend-exclude = [
    "tests/fixtures/evals",
    "tests/fixtures/canary/canary_shell.py",  # why: a deliberate S602; tests/security/test_canary.py scans it explicitly
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
# Logging + comment hygiene (logging-and-comments standard). CI's `touched` job runs
# `ruff check` (via pre-commit) on every file a PR touches (ADR-0018).
# T201 has only an unsafe fix, so `ruff check --fix` reports prints and never deletes them.
extend-select = [
    "LOG",              # logger misuse: Logger() direct, getLogger without __name__, root-logger calls
    "G",                # eager log formatting (G004 = f-string in log call), .warn, exc_info misuse
    "T20",              # print/pprint left in library code
    "BLE",              # blind `except Exception`
    "S",                # flake8-bandit security rules, the Python security gate (M8, ruff-only); incl. S110/S112 silent swallows
    "TRY400", "TRY401", # use logger.exception in except; don't repeat the exception in the message
    "D",                # docstrings, google convention (incl. D417 undocumented Args) (T8)
    "TD",               # TODO format: TODO(owner/issue): text
    "ERA",              # commented-out code
    "RUF100",           # unused noqa: a suppression that suppresses nothing is removed (T8)
    "PGH003", "PGH004", # blanket `type: ignore` / `noqa`: name the code you silence (T8)
    "C901",             # cyclomatic complexity (KISS, T11 §3)
    "PLR0913",          # too many arguments (KISS, T11 §3)
    "W605",             # invalid escape sequence: a SyntaxWarning on Python 3.12+, an error later
]
# Touched files comply in full (D8): CI lints only the files a PR touches, so the
# pre-existing docstring gaps are paid down as files are edited, not all at once.
# PLR2004 (magic values) is deliberately not selected: constants are review-only (T8).
extend-ignore = [
    "D107",  # why: the class docstring documents __init__ args (google style, T8)
    "TD003", # why: wants an issue URL line; it rejects TODO(ADR-NNNN), which TODO001 accepts (T8)
]

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
convention = "google"

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 10  # why: ruff/flake8 default; Ste's T11 §3 ceiling for one function

[tool.ruff.lint.pylint]
max-args = 6  # why: one over ruff's 5 — leaves room for a keyword-only flag (T11 §3)

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# print IS the interface for CLIs (data -> stdout); tests need no docstrings.
"**/cli.py" = ["T20"]
"**/__main__.py" = ["T20"]
"src/aa_ma/forks.py" = ["T20"]  # run as `python -m aa_ma.forks`; stdout is its report
"src/aa_ma/deps.py" = ["T20"]   # run as `python -m aa_ma.deps` (aa_ma_deps helper); stdout is its report
"scripts/**" = ["T20"]
# tests run git/bash on purpose (S603/S607), write tmp fixtures (S108) and assert (S101) — approved M8.2.
"tests/**" = ["D", "T20", "S101", "S108", "S110", "S603", "S607"]

[tool.commitizen]
# Releases are cut by scripts/release.sh (docs/runbooks/release.md): it promotes the curated
# `## Unreleased` CHANGELOG section and the README "Current version" line, then `cz bump`
# updates version_files and commits everything (-a) under an annotated tag. cz never writes
# the CHANGELOG — update_changelog_on_bump=true replaced curated notes with commit subjects
# every release from v0.7.0 to v0.11.0 (lessons L-006/L-008).
name = "cz_conventional_commits"
version_provider = "pep621"
tag_format = "v$version"
update_changelog_on_bump = false
annotated_tag = true
bump_message = "bump: version $current_version → $new_version\n\n[ad-hoc]"
version_files = [
    "VERSION:__version__",
]
# uv.lock records the project version; re-lock after cz writes version_files so the -a
# commit (and the tag) carry a consistent lock. release.sh refuses to push otherwise.
pre_bump_hooks = ["uv lock --quiet"]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "axor-core"
version = "0.11.0"
description = "Provider-agnostic governance kernel for agent systems"
readme = "README.md"
license = { text = "Apache-2.0" }
requires-python = ">=3.11"
keywords = ["agents", "governance", "llm", "ai"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: Apache Software License",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries",
]

# Core has zero required dependencies — by design.
# Provider SDKs live in adapter packages (axor-claude, axor-openai, axor-openrouter).
dependencies = []

[project.optional-dependencies]
# Asymmetric (ed25519) federation receipt signing. Core stays dependency-free; the
# symmetric HMAC signer needs nothing. Install this only for asymmetric A2A trust.
federation = [
    "cryptography>=42.0",
]
# Declarative governance config loaded from YAML (GovernanceConfig.from_yaml).
# Core stays dependency-free; from_dict works without this.
config = [
    "PyYAML>=6.0",
]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.23",
    "pytest-cov>=5.0",
    "hypothesis>=6.100",
    "import-linter>=2.0",
]
mutation = [
    "mutmut>=2.4",
]

[project.urls]
"Bug Tracker" = "https://github.com/Bucha11/axor-core/issues"
Changelog = "https://github.com/Bucha11/axor-core/releases"
Repository = "https://github.com/Bucha11/axor-core"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["axor_core"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
testpaths = ["tests"]
markers = [
    "adversarial: end-to-end attacker scenarios and soundness fuzzing (CI gate)",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["axor_core"]
omit = ["tests/*"]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "@abstractmethod",
]

[tool.mutmut]
# Mutation testing targets the enforcement core — survivors here mean an
# invariant is not actually exercised by a test (see Phase 3 of the roadmap).
paths_to_mutate = "axor_core/capability/lease_validator.py,axor_core/taint/engine.py,axor_core/degradation/engine.py,axor_core/node/export.py"
runner = "python -m pytest tests/ -x -q"

[project]
name = "django-eav2"
version = "2.0.0"
description = "Entity-Attribute-Value storage for Django"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = [
  "database",
  "django",
  "django-eav2",
  "eav",
  "sql",
]
license = "LGPL-3.0-or-later"
license-files = [ "LICENSE" ]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
classifiers = [
  "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
  "Environment :: Web Environment",
  "Framework :: Django",
  "Framework :: Django :: 5.2",
  "Framework :: Django :: 6.0",
  "Framework :: Django :: 6.1",
  "Intended Audience :: Developers",
  "Programming Language :: Python",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.15",
  "Topic :: Database",
  "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",
  "Typing :: Typed",
]
dependencies = [
  "django>=5.2,<6.2",
]
[[project.authors]]
name = "Mauro Lizaur"
email = "mauro@sdf.org"
[project.urls]
Changelog = "https://github.com/jazzband/django-eav2/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md"
Documentation = "https://django-eav2.readthedocs.io/en/latest/"
Issues = "https://github.com/jazzband/django-eav2/issues"
Repository = "https://github.com/jazzband/django-eav2"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
  "poethepoet>=0.34,<1",
  { include-group = "lint" },
  { include-group = "test" },
]
test = [
  "hypothesis>=6.87.1,<7",
  "pytest>=7.4.3,<10",
  "pytest-cov>=4.1,<8",
  "pytest-django>=4.5.2,<5",
  "pytest-randomly>=3.15,<6",
  "pytest-timeout>=2.4,<3",
]
docs = [
  "shibuya>=2026.1,<2027",
  "sphinx>=8.1,<10",
  "sphinx-copybutton>=0.5,<0.6",
]
lint = [
  "dennis>=1.1,<2",
  "django-stubs[compatible-mypy]>=6,<7",
  "import-linter>=2.5,<3",
  "mypy>=1.6,<3",
  "pyright>=1.1,<2",
  "ruff>=0.6.3,<0.18",
  "wemake-python-styleguide>=1.8,<2",
]
mysql = [ "mysqlclient>=2.2,<3" ]
postgres = [ "psycopg[binary]>=3.2,<4" ]

[tool.hatch]
[tool.hatch.build]
# Compiled translations are gitignored but must still ship:
artifacts = [ "*.mo" ]
targets.wheel.packages = [ "eav" ]
targets.sdist.include = [
  "eav/",
  "CHANGELOG.md",
  "LICENSE",
  "README.md",
]

[tool.uv]
default-groups = [ "dev" ]
# Docs: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/settings
add-bounds = "major"

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py310"
line-length = 88
[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [ "ALL" ]
ignore = [
  "ANN",    # Type hints related, let mypy handle these.
  "ARG",    # Unused arguments
  "CPY001", # Copyright notices
  "D100",   # Module docstrings
  "D104",   # Package docstrings
  "D105",   # Magic method docstrings
  "D106",   # Nested class docstrings, such as Meta
  "D107",   # __init__ docstrings
  "D212",   # Multi-line summaries may start on the second line
  "D404",   # First word of the docstring
  "D405",   # Section name capitalization
  "EM101",  # "Exception must not use a string literal, assign to variable first"
  "EM102",  # "Exception must not use an f-string literal, assign to variable first"
  "PD",     # Pandas related
  "Q000",   # For now
  "SIM105", # "Use contextlib.suppress({exception}) instead of try-except-pass"
  "TRY003", # "Avoid specifying long messages outside the exception class"
]
# Migrations are special
per-file-ignores."**/migrations/*" = [ "D", "RUF012" ]
# Sphinx specific
per-file-ignores."docs/source/conf.py" = [ "D", "INP001" ]
# Allow private member access for Registry
per-file-ignores."eav/registry.py" = [ "SLF001" ]
per-file-ignores."test_project/**" = [ "D" ]
# pytest is even more special
per-file-ignores."tests/*" = [
  "D",       # Tests are named for what they check
  "INP001",  # "Add an __init__.py"
  "PLR2004", # "Magic value used in comparison"
  "PLW0108", # "Lambda may be unnecessary" - used with assertRaises
  "PT009",   # "Use a regular assert instead of unittest-style"
  "PT027",   # "Use pytest.raises instead of unittest-style"
  "PT030",   # "pytest.warns match parameter" - broad warnings intentional in tests
  "S101",    # "Use of assert detected"
  "SLF001"  # "Private member accessed"
]
# Rules that flake8 (wemake-python-styleguide) checks, so `# noqa: WPSnnn` is valid.
external = [ "WPS" ]
flake8-implicit-str-concat.allow-multiline = false
# Use Google-style docstrings.
pydocstyle.convention = "google"

[tool.codespell]
# Docs: https://github.com/codespell-project/codespell
skip = "*.lock,*.po,CONTRIBUTORS.md,eav/migrations,htmlcov"

[tool.pyproject-fmt]
# Docs: https://pyproject-fmt.readthedocs.io/en/latest/configuration.html
column_width = 88
generate_python_version_classifiers = false
table_format = "long"

[tool.typos.files]
# Docs: https://github.com/crate-ci/typos
extend-exclude = [ "*.lock", "*.po", "CONTRIBUTORS.md", "eav/migrations" ]

[tool.mypy]
files = [ "eav" ]
exclude = [ "eav/migrations/" ]
warn_unreachable = true
local_partial_types = true
enable_error_code = [
  "ignore-without-code",
  "redundant-expr",
  "truthy-bool",
  "truthy-iterable",
]
strict_equality_for_none = true
strict = true
# mypy config: https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/config_file.html
plugins = [ "mypy_django_plugin.main" ]

[tool.pyright]
venv = ".venv"
venvPath = "."
typeCheckingMode = "standard"
# pyright config: https://microsoft.github.io/pyright/#/configuration
include = [ "eav" ]
exclude = [ "**/migrations" ]

[tool.django-stubs]
django_settings_module = "test_project.settings"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = [
  "--strict-markers",
  "--strict-config",
  "--doctest-modules",
  "--ignore=docs",
  "--cov=eav",
  "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered",
  "--cov-report=xml",
  "--cov-branch",
  "--cov-fail-under=95",
]
xfail_strict = true
filterwarnings = [ "error" ]
# pytest config: https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/reference/customize.html
DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE = "test_project.settings"
timeout = 20

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = [
  "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
  "pragma: no cover",
]
skip_covered = true
show_missing = true
sort = "Cover"

[tool.poe]
[tool.poe.tasks]
# Docs: https://poethepoet.natn.io

# ===================================================================
# Ruff (Linter + Formatter)
# 核心代码质量工具，集成了数十种工具，速度极快。
# 负责：代码风格检查、自动格式化、导入排序、坏味道重构等。
# ===================================================================
[tool.ruff]
required-version = ">=0.6.0"
# 设置与 Black 兼容的行长。
line-length = 88
# 指定你的项目支持的最低 Python 版本。
target-version = "py313"

# 指定 Ruff 需要检查的源代码和测试目录。
src = ["packages", "apps/backend", "scripts", "tooling"]

# 全局排除不需要检查的文件和目录。
exclude = [
    ".bzr",
    ".direnv",
    ".eggs",
    ".git",
    ".hg",
    ".nox",
    ".pants.d",
    ".ruff_cache",
    ".svn",
    ".tox",
    ".venv",
    "__pypackages__",
    "_build",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "node_modules",
    "venv",
    "scripts/learning",
]

cache-dir = ".ruff_cache"
respect-gitignore = true
force-exclude = true

# --- Ruff Linter (检查器) 配置 ---
[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E",
    "F",
    "W",
    "C90",
    "I",
    "N",
    "UP",
    "B",
    "A",
    "C4",
    "SIM",
    "PTH",
    "PLC",
    "PLE",
    "PLR",
    "PLW",
    "RUF",
    "D",
    "PT",
    "ANN",
    "S",
    "T20",
]

ignore = [
    "B008",   # 允许函数调用作为默认参数（FastAPI Depends）
    "N803",   # 函数参数命名：第三方库适配（numpy 矩阵变量等）
    "N806",   # 函数内变量命名：数学/科学计算常量（X, XtX, CONVERGENCE_TOL 等）
    "N818",   # DittoException 基类命名是设计选择
    "RUF002", # 中文标点符号
    "RUF003", # 中文注释标点符号
    "D203",   # 与 Black 冲突
    "D212",   # 与 Black 冲突
    "D100",   # 模块必须有文档字符串
    "D107",   # __init__ 文档字符串
    "D400",   # 文档字符串句号结尾（中文不适用）
    "D415",   # 文档字符串首行标点
    "D401",   # 祈使语气
    "PT011",  # pytest.raises match 参数
    "SIM105", # contextlib.suppress
    "SIM117", # 嵌套 with 语句
]

unfixable = []

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# SignalDelivery - 环境变量名（非实际密钥）是 Bandit S105 已知误报
"apps/backend/src/ditto_apps/registry/infra/signal_delivery.py" = ["S105"]
# Prefect 装饰器 mock 包装任意可调用，签名必然 Any（与 stub 文件同理）
"apps/backend/src/ditto_apps/prefect_mock.py" = ["ANN401"]
# ResearchDatasetFacade.export() - 表名来自系统 dataset_id，非用户输入
"apps/backend/src/ditto_apps/services/derived/research.py" = ["S608"]
# ResearchDatasetExport - dataset_id is validated by _sanitize_table_name
"packages/analysis/src/ditto_analysis/storage/sqlite/research/export.py" = ["S608"]
# Protocol 属性用 ``...`` 省略体是标准惯例，D102 不适用
"packages/portfolio/src/ditto_portfolio/rebalancing/report_views.py" = ["D102"]
# Protocol 接口方法用 ``...`` 省略体是标准惯例，D102 不适用
"packages/data/src/ditto_data/storage/base/protocols.py" = ["D102"]
# 第三方 stub 文件包含 Any 类型签名，无法修改
"typings/**/*.pyi" = ["ANN401"]

# 测试文件 - 最宽松（所有 tests/ 目录通用）
"**/tests/**/*.py" = [
    "PLR2004",
    "PLR0913",
    "S101",
    "S106",
    "S311",
    "S608",
    "ANN",
    "D",
    "PLC0415",
    "C901",
    "S105",
    "S108",
    "S110",
]
"**/conftest.py" = ["ANN", "D", "PLC0415"]

# --- Ruff Formatter (格式化器) 配置 ---
[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
skip-magic-trailing-comma = false
line-ending = "auto"

[tool.inline-snapshot]
format-command = "ruff format --stdin-filename {filename}"

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-annotations]
suppress-none-returning = true
suppress-dummy-args = true

[tool.ruff.lint.pylint]
max-statements = 50
max-args = 7
max-branches = 12
max-returns = 6

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 10

# flake8-tidy-imports: 禁止特定 API 导入
[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api]
"pandas".msg = "Use polars instead"

# ===================================================================
# BasedPyright (类型检查) - Pyright fork，更严格的默认设置
#
# 策略：standard 打底 + 核心目录 strict
# 优势：
#   1. 避免全仓 strict 导致的噪音爆炸
#   2. 核心业务逻辑获得最严格检查
#   3. 边缘模块保持灵活性
#   4. 更多诊断规则默认启用，更好的 AI coding 支持
# ===================================================================
[tool.basedpyright]
pythonVersion = "3.13"
pythonPlatform = "All"
stubPath = "typings"

# 显式指定 uv 管理的虚拟环境，确保 VS Code 扩展和 CLI 都能正确定位
venvPath = "."
venv = ".venv"

# 核心：standard 模式打底（比 basic 严格，比 strict 宽松）
typeCheckingMode = "standard"

# 源码目录（tests 用独立配置 pyright.tests.json）
include = ["packages/**/src", "apps/backend/src"]

# 排除目录（tests 用独立配置）
exclude = [
    "**/__pycache__",
    "**/node_modules",
    ".venv",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "tests",
    "**/tests",
]

# VS Code 体验：tests 打开也不出红黄线（诊断被抑制）
ignore = [
    "tests",
    "tests/**",
    "**/tests/**",
    "packages/*/tests/**",
    "apps/backend/tests/**",
    # MarketQueryService: multi-line error message uses implicit string concatenation
    # (已迁移至 services/)
]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 关键：核心目录提升到 strict 模式
# 这些是最值钱的代码，值得最严格的检查
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
strict = ["packages/**/src"]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 规则微调：让 Ruff 管风格，Pyright 专注类型
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Ruff 已经管了这些
reportUnusedImport = "none"
reportUnusedVariable = "none"

# 第三方库 stub 不完整时的处理
reportMissingTypeStubs = "warning"

# 检测不必要的 type: ignore 注释
reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComment = "error"

# 检测隐式字符串拼接
reportImplicitStringConcatenation = "error"

# 对于 standard 模式下的 Unknown 类型，降级为 warning
# 这样编辑器里能看到黄线提醒，但不会阻塞 CI
#reportUnknownMemberType = "warning"
#reportUnknownArgumentType = "warning"
#reportUnknownVariableType = "warning"

# 私有成员访问（测试和内部模块可能需要）
#reportPrivateUsage = "warning"

# 告诉 Pyright 源码根目录（解决 import 路径问题）
extraPaths = [
    "packages/platform/src",
    "packages/kernel/src",
    "packages/data/src",
    "packages/features/src",
    "packages/analysis/src",
    "packages/strategy/src",
    "packages/portfolio/src",
    "packages/risk/src",
    "packages/execution/src",
    "packages/backtest/src",
    "packages/application/src",
    "apps/backend/src",
]

# ===================================================================
# Pytest (测试框架)
# ===================================================================
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "7.0"
testpaths = ["packages/*/tests", "apps/backend/tests"]
python_files = ["test_*.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
pythonpath = [
    ".",
    "packages/platform/src",
    "packages/kernel/src",
    "packages/data/src",
    "packages/features/src",
    "packages/analysis/src",
    "packages/strategy/src",
    "packages/portfolio/src",
    "packages/risk/src",
    "packages/execution/src",
    "packages/backtest/src",
    "packages/application/src",
    "apps/backend/src",
]

filterwarnings = ["error", "ignore::UserWarning", "ignore::DeprecationWarning"]

markers = [
    "unit: Mark test as a unit test",
    "integration: Mark test as an integration test",
    "e2e: Mark test as an end-to-end test",
    "slow: Mark test as slow running (skip with -m 'not slow')",
    "serial: Mark test that must run serially",
    "capacity: Mark scheduler-capacity slow-lane test (dedicated CI job)",
    "snapshot: Mark test that uses inline-snapshot (must run serially)",
    "pit: Mark test as Point-in-Time validation (no future data leak)",
    "sandbox_live: Physical OCI sandbox acceptance requiring the approved runtime",
    "cli_test: CLI tests that disable observability auto-reset",
]

log_cli = true
log_cli_level = "INFO"
asyncio_mode = "strict"

# pytest-timeout 兜底防挂死；合法慢测试打 slow/capacity 标记进慢车道，不调大此值
timeout = 600

addopts = [
    "-ra",
    "-v",
    "--import-mode=importlib",
    "-n", "auto",           # 默认并行运行
    "--dist", "loadfile",   # 同文件测试串行（避免 snapshot 冲突）
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
    "--durations=10",       # 报告最慢的 10 个测试
]

# ===================================================================
# Coverage
# ===================================================================
[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
patch = ["subprocess"]
source = [
    "apps/backend/src/ditto_apps",
    "packages/agent/src/ditto_agent",
    "packages/analysis/src/ditto_analysis",
    "packages/application/src/ditto_application",
    "packages/backtest/src/ditto_backtest",
    "packages/data/src/ditto_data",
    "packages/execution/src/ditto_execution",
    "packages/features/src/ditto_features",
    "packages/kernel/src/ditto_kernel",
    "packages/platform/src/ditto_platform",
    "packages/portfolio/src/ditto_portfolio",
    "packages/risk/src/ditto_risk",
    "packages/strategy/src/ditto_strategy",
]
omit = ["**/generated/**", "**/tests/**"]

[tool.coverage.report]
precision = 2
show_missing = true
skip_covered = false
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "def __repr__",
    "def __str__",
    "raise AssertionError",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "@(abc\\.)?abstractmethod",
    "@overload",
    "class .*\\bProtocol\\):",
    "if self\\.debug:",
]
fail_under = 0
partial_branches = ["pragma: no branch", "if TYPE_CHECKING:"]

[tool.coverage.html]
directory = "htmlcov"

# ===================================================================
# Commitizen 配置

[tool.commitizen]
name = "cz_conventional_commits"
version = "0.1.0"
tag_format = "v$version"
update_changelog_on_bump = true
changelog_incremental = true

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "omnibase_core"
version = "0.47.50"
description = "ONEX Core Framework - Base classes and essential implementations"
authors = [
    {name = "OmniNode.ai", email = "contact@omninode.ai"}
]
license = { text = "MIT" }
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "onex",
    "framework",
    "architecture",
    "dependency-injection",
    "base-classes",
    "infrastructure",
    "event-driven",
    "error-handling",
    "node-architecture"
]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Application Frameworks",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",
    "Typing :: Typed"
]
dependencies = [
    "pydantic>=2.12.5,<3.0.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.2,<7.0.0",
    "dependency-injector>=4.49.1,<5.0.0",
    "deepdiff>=8.0.0,<10.0.0",
    "click>=8.3.1,<9.0.0",
    # OMN-15688 (2026-08-04): floor raised to 50.0.0 to clear two HIGH CVEs that
    # Trivy flags on the omninode-runtime image at cryptography 48.0.1 --
    # CVE-2026-69247 (PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption exposes a Bleichenbacher
    # oracle through distinguishable errors, fixed 50.0.0) and CVE-2026-69249
    # (duplicate self-signed intermediates cause exponential path-building,
    # fixed 49.0.0). The previous <50.0.0 ceiling made the fixed release
    # unreachable, blocking every runtime candidate rebuild (omnibase_infra
    # build-workspace-candidate-runtime.yml run 30878868464).
    # Platform consequence, decided 2026-09-30: the floor stays. PyPI ships no
    # macOS x86_64 wheel for cryptography 50, so on Intel macOS uv builds it from
    # source, which needs a Rust toolchain and OpenSSL 3 (brew install openssl@3
    # rust, OPENSSL_DIR=$(brew --prefix openssl@3)). Intel macOS is a supported
    # from-source platform, documented in the public Supported Platforms guide
    # and exercised by the nightly install canary. Lowering the floor to get
    # wheels would reopen both CVEs above, so it is not an option.
    "cryptography>=50.0.0,<51.0.0",
    "jsonschema>=4.25.1,<5.0.0",
    "httpx>=0.27.0,<1.0.0",
    "blake3>=1.0.8,<2.0.0",
    "ruamel-yaml>=0.18.0",
    "tree-sitter>=0.25.2,<0.27",
    "tree-sitter-python>=0.25.0,<0.26",
    "pathspec>=0.12.1",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/OmniNode-ai/omnibase_core"
Repository = "https://github.com/OmniNode-ai/omnibase_core"
Documentation = "https://github.com/OmniNode-ai/knowledge_base"

[project.scripts]
onex = "omnibase_core.cli.cli_commands:cli"
# Backward-compatibility alias (renamed from 'omni-agent' to 'onex' in v0.3.0)
omni-agent = "omnibase_core.cli.cli_commands:cli"
# Dev/test runtime host CLI (Phase 1 MVP - LocalHandler only)
# WARNING: For development and testing ONLY, not for production use
omninode-runtime-host-dev = "omnibase_core.cli.cli_runtime_host:main"
# OMN-19405 (typed work ledger T5): the read CLI; folds the JSON-lines ledger at
# ONEX_WORK_LEDGER_PATH and answers one query. Exit 0 CLEAR, 3 HELD/FOUND, 2 UNDECIDED.
onex-work-ledger = "omnibase_core.nodes.node_work_ledger_state_compute.runtime_work_ledger:main"
check-local-paths = "omnibase_core.validation.validator_local_paths:main"
check-github-token-env-reads = "omnibase_core.validation.validator_github_token_env_reads:main"
# OMN-20918 (OCC retirement S8): the imperative contract guard moved from onex_change_control;
# reads the caller's own allowlist and refuses one that gains a path against the merge base.
check-imperative-contracts = "omnibase_core.handlers.handler_imperative_contract_guard_cli:main"
# OMN-19998: refuse a dependency on a repository at the same or a higher layer of
# the declared order, through any channel; every repository runs it via
# .github/workflows/dependency-direction.yml and the pre-commit hook.
check-dependency-direction = "omnibase_core.handlers.handler_dependency_direction_cli:main"
# OMN-19998: version drift at source. Refuse a floor raise on a sibling registry
# package ahead of the registry consumers that install it, and a job the merge
# queue runs that pull request CI skips; every repository runs both via
# .github/workflows/version-drift.yml and the pre-commit hooks.
check-version-floor-consumers = "omnibase_core.handlers.handler_version_floor_consumers_cli:main"
check-merge-queue-parity = "omnibase_core.handlers.handler_merge_queue_parity_cli:main"
# OMN-19998: CI runners are for private repositories only (RULING 2026-10-16T07:07:09Z).
# Refuse a public repository adding a job whose runs-on is, or can resolve to, a
# self-hosted label, against the shrink-only baseline shipped in the package; every
# repository runs it via .github/workflows/version-drift.yml and the pre-commit hook.
check-public-runner-placement = "omnibase_core.handlers.handler_public_runner_placement_cli:main"
# OMN-19998: internal siblings resolve from dev merge tags, never a release, sha or branch.
check-internal-sibling-pins = "omnibase_core.handlers.handler_internal_sibling_pins_cli:main"
# OMN-14401: reject config/registry YAML files declaring duplicate ids over a
# non-unique key (checked registries are config-as-data via a manifest file).
check-duplicate-registry-ids = "omnibase_core.validation.validator_duplicate_config_ids:main"
# OMN-13293 (G1): the same local-paths check executed as a COMPUTE node over the
# in-memory event bus (two-transport seam; Kafka backend in CI). Proven
# equivalent to check-local-paths on the G1 corpus + 6999-file shadow-bake.
check-local-paths-compute = "omnibase_core.nodes.node_local_paths_check_compute.runtime_local_paths_check:main"
# OMN-13294 (G2): hardcoded private-IP (RFC1918) scanner, same COMPUTE/bus seam.
# Generated by node_generation_consumer and corpus-accepted.
check-private-ip-compute = "omnibase_core.nodes.node_private_ip_check_compute.runtime_private_ip_check:main"
# OMN-13497: no-faked-boundary scanner (bans hand-written fakes/stubs of the
# inference/routing/dispatch boundary), same COMPUTE/bus seam. Generated by
# node_generation_consumer and corpus-accepted. Lands report-only.
check-no-faked-boundary = "omnibase_core.validation.no_faked_boundary.runtime_no_faked_boundary:main"
# OMN-13480 (G2, SEA-dogfood): the TODO-marker scanner names its own subject tokens here.  # onex-allow-todo-marker OMN-13480 reason="describes the marker scanner; not agent-left unfinished work"
# scanner, same COMPUTE/bus seam. Generated by node_generation_consumer against the
# live model and corpus-accepted on the first attempt.
check-todo-fixme-marker-compute = "omnibase_core.validation.todo_marker.runtime_todo_marker:main"
# OMN-13509 (G2, SEA-dogfood): sibling pin-hygiene scanner (blocks off-dev-line
# omnibase-core/spi/compat git pins), same COMPUTE/bus seam. Generated by
# node_generation_consumer against the live model and corpus-accepted on the first
# attempt; git ancestry resolved at the EFFECT boundary. PR-time sibling of the
# deploy-time OMN-12977 guard.
check-pin-hygiene-compute = "omnibase_core.validation.pin_hygiene.runtime_pin_hygiene:main"
# OMN-13480 (G2 residual, SEA-dogfood): hardcoded localhost/loopback URL scanner
# (blocks http(s)://localhost / http(s)://127.0.0.1 literals — the loopback
# endpoints url-authority's public-https-literal rule excludes), same COMPUTE/bus
# seam. Generated by node_generation_consumer against the live model and
# corpus-accepted.
check-localhost-url-compute = "omnibase_core.validation.localhost_url.runtime_localhost_url:main"
# OMN-13294 (G2, SEA-dogfood): hardcoded onex.* topic-string scanner (blocks
# pasted onex.<a>.<b>.<c> topic literals that should be contract-declared), same
# COMPUTE/bus seam. Generated by node_generation_consumer against the live model
# and corpus-accepted on the first attempt.
check-hardcoded-topic-compute = "omnibase_core.nodes.node_hardcoded_topic_check_compute.runtime_hardcoded_topic_check:main"
# OMN-13569: doc-content COMPUTE validator (blocks local-environment traces +
# Linear ticket references in documentation), same COMPUTE/bus seam. Generated by

# Strict mode enables: warn_return_any, warn_unused_configs, disallow_untyped_defs,

# no_implicit_optional, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores, strict_equality, and more
strict = true

python_version = "3.12"
mypy_path = "src"
namespace_packages = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src", "."]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function"
markers = [
    "unit: Unit tests that test individual components in isolation",
    "integration: Integration tests that test multiple components together",
    "slow: Tests that take a long time to run (>1s)",
    "smoke: Quick smoke tests for basic functionality",
    "performance: Performance and benchmark tests",
    "cache: Cache-related tests",
    "nodes: Node architecture tests",
    "validation: Validation framework tests",
    "flaky: Marks tests as flaky and allows reruns (from pytest-rerunfailures)",
    "timeout: Timeout for individual tests using pytest-timeout plugin (e.g., @pytest.mark.timeout(60))"
]
addopts = [
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
    "-ra",
    "--tb=short",
    "-n4",  # Limit parallel workers to prevent OOM (was: auto)
    "--timeout=60",  # Prevent hanging tests (60s per test)
    # OMN-15977: signal-based timeout, NOT thread-based. pytest-timeout's
    # thread method spawns a watcher thread that fires SIGKILL-equivalent only
    # when the GIL is released -- a CPU-bound pure-Python loop holding the GIL
    # continuously (e.g. a runaway regex/compute path) never yields, so the
    # watcher thread never gets scheduled and the "timeout" never fires. This
    # was the unkillable-CPU config behind two 2026-08-12 runaways (46min,
    # 53min) that a health-tick had to SIGKILL manually. Signal method
    # delivers SIGALRM, which interrupts at the next Python bytecode boundary
    # regardless of GIL contention -- it can actually kill a CPU-bound loop.
    "--timeout-method=signal",

    "--dist=loadgroup",  # Group tests by @pytest.mark.xdist_group for better control
    "--reruns=2",  # Auto-retry failed tests twice (handles flaky tests)
    "--reruns-delay=1",  # 1 second delay between reruns
]
filterwarnings = [
    # === Deprecation Warning Capture (OMN-199, Phase 7) ===
    # Display deprecation warnings during test runs so developers can address them
    # before v0.5.0 when these will become errors
    "default::DeprecationWarning",
    "default::PendingDeprecationWarning",
    # Suppress asyncio "Task was destroyed but it is pending!" warnings
    # These are expected during test cleanup when fixtures cancel pending tasks
    # The cleanup fixtures (event_loop_cleanup, cleanup_service_tasks) properly
    # cancel tasks, so these warnings are cosmetic and don't indicate real issues
    "ignore:.*Task was destroyed but it is pending.*:RuntimeWarning",
    # NOTE: "coroutine was never awaited" warnings are NOT suppressed
    # These indicate real bugs where async functions were called but never executed
    # If you encounter this warning, FIX the test by properly awaiting the coroutine
]
# Memory optimization notes:
# - Limited to 4 workers to prevent OOM on machines with 16GB RAM
# - Use --timeout to prevent hanging tests accumulating memory
# - Use --dist=loadscope to group tests by module (reduces import overhead)
# Test execution strategies:
#   Fast iteration: -n 2 --timeout=30
#   Full suite: -n 4 --timeout=60 (default)
#   CI/Large machines: -n 8 --timeout=120
#   Debug single test: -n 0 (disable xdist)
#
# Intelligent test selection with pytest-testmon:
#   Run only affected tests: uv run pytest --testmon
#   Reset testmon database: uv run pytest --testmon-noselect
#   Disable testmon: uv run pytest --testmon-off
#   Note: .testmondata file is gitignored and stores test dependencies

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["src/omnibase_core"]
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/archived/*",
    "*/archive/*",
    "*/__pycache__/*",
    "*/site-packages/*"
]
branch = true
parallel = true

[tool.coverage.report]
precision = 2
show_missing = true
skip_covered = false
fail_under = 60
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "def __repr__",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "raise AssertionError",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "if typing.TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "@abstractmethod",
    "@abc.abstractmethod"
]
